name: Login Bell
summary: Hear a soft chime the moment a friend or guildmate logs in, with their name in chat.
logoPrompt: A small polished brass hand bell standing upright in the centre, its rim catching warm light, with soft curved sound waves rising from it

cover.tagline: Know when your people log in.
bullets: One sound, one clear chat line

description: **Login Bell plays a short sound and writes a clear line in chat whenever a friend or guild member comes online, so you never miss them.**
- Rings for character friends, Battle.net friends and guild members.
- A chat line that says who it is and whether it is a friend or guild member, with a clickable name.
- Reads the game's own online message, so it works in every client language.
- No spam: the same person rings at most once every 5 minutes, and a crowd logging in at once plays one sound.
It starts on its own. Type `/lb` (or `/loginbell`) to see the settings. `/lb sound`, `/lb friends` and `/lb guild` switch each part on or off, `/lb test` plays the bell.
- Works on Retail. No combat data and no window.
- It stays quiet for 15 seconds after login or a reload, while the game fills its lists.
- Friends who only open the mobile app are skipped.
- Settings are shared by all your characters.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
